text_simplified: The National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) provides support for clinical trials aimed at new treatments, helping to determine whether these treatments are safe and effective.

review_defects.why: The Arabic literally means 'for treating addiction to children's games' (i.e., games intended for children), while the English implies children are the ones addicted to gaming. This shifts the subject of the addiction.

Arabic 'for new treatments' indicates the trials are conducted for the purpose of developing new treatments, whereas English 'of new treatments' suggests the trials are testing those treatments. The relationship is altered.
